name: 12307 · Schenectady, NY
findings: ZIP 12307 (Schenectady) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 12 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12307 (Schenectady) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12307 (Schenectady) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
